method: Independent long-word source-coverage comparison for every question, followed by manual inspection of all 15 flagged cases; manual detailed source/JSON comparisons and four packaged-figure visual checks as recorded. This check does not claim a full second visual inspection of every page. Separate subagent audit covers answers and scoring.
